plotTwists: {user} and {target} both go for the high five and completely miss, hitting nothing but air. Somehow it's still iconic.
The high five is so powerful it triggers a small firework display overhead.
A stray cat leaps up and intercepts the high five, claiming the moment as its own.
The high five becomes a full chain — three random NPCs join in unprompted.
{user} trips right before the high five, and they end up bumping elbows instead. Somehow it still counts.
The Whisper Merchant appears and offers to bottle the positive energy and sell it.
Time loops back and the high five happens twice before anyone notices.

npcInteractions.line: Now THAT'S the energy I like to see in my tavern.
Reminds me of the day my team won the championship. Good stuff.
Even my roots feel more energized after that one.
The King has been notified and approves wholeheartedly.
I don't sell high fives, but I respect free positive energy.
The winds carried whispers of celebration for miles.
